event_detail: Bread slice in the toaster: the gripper comes down onto the bread (52.8-54.4 s) with fingers closed together beside it, then pulls back and moves away (56.0-57.6 s) while the bread stays standing in the toaster slot.
evidence: Wrist camera at 52.8/54.4 s shows the bread right at the closed finger tips; at 56.0 s and 57.6 s the bread is farther away, still in the slot, and nothing is between the fingers. Both shoulder views at 57.6 s show the bread still sticking up from the left slot of the toaster and the arm pulled back. Stage 1 is judged done because the bread is up out of the slot and the robot has moved on to the bread, but I cannot see the lever cycle in this clip. Both toaster levers are at the top of their tracks, so the toaster is not running now. That fits a finished toast cycle, but an unpushed lever looks the same.
